tools.name: search_credit_control_cases
tools.description: Search cases already held in the signed-in SHVL workspace by customer name or invoice reference. Read-only, account-scoped and capped at 20 results.

tools.name: get_credit_control_case
tools.description: Return one case from the signed-in SHVL workspace, including status, payment-readiness state, bounded invoice summaries and communication evidence. Excludes email addresses, message content, provider IDs and payment records.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyse_aged_debtors_csv, get_credit_control_case · Private data: get_credit_control_case · Public sink: analyse_aged_debtors_csv, get_credit_control_case.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyse_aged_debtors_csv, get_credit_control_case · Private data: get_credit_control_case · Public sink: analyse_aged_debtors_csv, get_credit_control_case

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_credit_control_brief" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return the signed-in SHVL workspace's current overdue summary and five highest-priority cases. Read-only. Uses the latest SHVL import or completed accounting sync and never sends a reminder." → after: "Use when someone asks who owes money, which invoices are overdue or which customers need a payment reminder. Return the selected business's overdue totals and up to five customers to check first. Read-only. Uses the latest SHVL import or completed accounting sync and never sends a reminder."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
